property_summary: For any valid _feeRate (<=5000), after initialize(...) completes the contract's public feeRate equals the supplied _feeRate; the mutant sets feeRate to the constant 5000 instead, so for some inputs (where _feeRate != 5000) the mutant will violate this property.
change_summary: Assign feeRate from a constant maximum (5000) instead of the provided _feeRate, changing the stored feeRate after initialize.
